datatype.name: SeatingCapacity
datatype.definition: A non-negative count of student seats in a teaching space.

datatype.name: GradeValue
datatype.definition: A numeric grade value. The admissible range depends on the GradingScale it is recorded against (recorded per Mark), so no single bound is fixed here.

enumeration.name: ISCEDLevel
enumeration.definition: Levels of education of the UNESCO International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED 2011).

provenance.source: UNESCO-UIS, International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED 2011), UIS/2012/INS/10 REV

enumeration.name: GradingScale
enumeration.definition: Named grading scales against which a numeric Mark is interpreted. Scales are jurisdiction-specific.

provenance.note: An open, extensible set; the enumerated members are common national scales, each sourced.

value.definition: Romanian school scale, integers/decimals from 1 (lowest) to 10 (highest); pass >= 5.

concept.name: EducationalInstitution
concept.definition: An organisation whose primary purpose is to provide education through one or more educational programmes.

provenance.source: UNESCO-UIS, International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED 2011), UIS/2012/INS/10 REV

property.name: iscedLevels
property.definition: The ISCED levels of education the institution provides.

provenance.source: UNESCO-UIS, International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED 2011), UIS/2012/INS/10 REV

provenance.note: Deliberately a relation, not inheritance — the key modelling point of this domain.

concept.name: School
concept.definition: An institution providing primary and/or secondary education (typically ISCED levels 1-3).

provenance.source: UNESCO-UIS, International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED 2011), UIS/2012/INS/10 REV

concept.name: SchoolBuilding
concept.definition: A building designed for or used by a school to deliver education.

provenance.note: The physical counterpart of a School; a genuine is-a of Building (unlike School itself).

concept.name: Classroom
concept.definition: A room in which a class of students is taught.

provenance.note: A functional specialisation of Room; its containment in a building is the inherited part_of relation.

property.name: seatingCapacity
property.definition: The number of students the classroom is furnished to seat.

concept.name: Laboratory
concept.definition: A room equipped for practical scientific, technical or computing instruction.

property.name: discipline
property.definition: The discipline the laboratory is equipped for (e.g. chemistry, physics, informatics).

concept.name: CurriculumSubject
concept.definition: A branch of knowledge studied and taught as part of a curriculum (e.g. Mathematics, Biology, Music). An abstract entity; the specific subjects are reference individuals at L2.

provenance.source: UNESCO-UIS, ISCED Fields of Education and Training 2013 (ISCED-F 2013)

property.name: iscedfField
property.definition: The ISCED-F 2013 field of education and training this subject belongs to.

provenance.source: UNESCO-UIS, ISCED Fields of Education and Training 2013 (ISCED-F 2013)

concept.name: Mark
concept.definition: A grade awarded to a student for a curriculum subject: a numeric value on a named grading scale, at a point in time. Reified so the (student, subject, value, date) fact is a first-class object [meta-model §10 Q5].

provenance.note: Reification of an n-ary assessment relation.

property.name: scale
property.definition: The grading scale against which the value is interpreted.

property.name: awardedOn
property.definition: The date on which the mark was awarded.

relation.name: forSubject
relation.definition: The curriculum subject the mark assesses.

concept.name: StudentClass
concept.definition: A cohort of students taught together as a unit (a "class" or "form"). A Collection: a many-as-one with its own identity, label and tutor.

property.name: label
property.definition: The class's identifying label within its school (e.g. "9A").

property.name: studyYear
property.definition: The year/grade level of study the class is in.

relation.name: atSchool
relation.definition: The school the class belongs to.

role.name: Student
role.definition: The role of a person enrolled at an educational institution to follow a programme of study.

provenance.source: UNESCO-UIS, International Standard Classification of Education (ISCED 2011), UIS/2012/INS/10 REV
provenance.note: Enrolment is a contextual, time-bounded relation — modelled as a role, not a kind of Person.

property.name: enrolmentId
property.definition: The identifier the institution assigns to the enrolled student.

property.name: studyYear
property.definition: The year/grade the student is currently enrolled in.

role.name: Teacher
role.definition: The role of a person who instructs students in one or more curriculum subjects.

provenance.source: ILO International Standard Classification of Occupations (ISCO-08), Major group 2 'Professionals', Sub-major 23 'Teaching professionals'
provenance.note: An occupation/role of a Person, not a kind of Person.

property.name: staffId
property.definition: The identifier the institution assigns to the teacher.

role.name: FormTutor
role.definition: The role of a teacher additionally responsible for the pastoral oversight and administration of one specific class/form. Known in Romanian as "diriginte" (English: form tutor / homeroom teacher).

provenance.note: A role held IN ADDITION TO the Teacher role by the same Person; co-held, not a subclass of Teacher (roles are never in `extends`, S3). Alt labels: ro 'diriginte', en 'homeroom teacher'.

individual.name: Mathematics
individual.definition: The study of quantity, structure, space and change.

provenance.source: UNESCO-UIS, ISCED Fields of Education and Training 2013 (ISCED-F 2013)

individual.name: RomanianLanguage
individual.definition: The study of the Romanian language and its literature.

provenance.source: UNESCO-UIS, ISCED Fields of Education and Training 2013 (ISCED-F 2013)

individual.name: Biology
individual.definition: The study of living organisms and their vital processes.

provenance.source: UNESCO-UIS, ISCED Fields of Education and Training 2013 (ISCED-F 2013)

individual.name: Music
individual.definition: The study of organised sound, its theory, performance and history.

provenance.source: UNESCO-UIS, ISCED Fields of Education and Training 2013 (ISCED-F 2013)
